using UnityEngine;

[AddComponentMenu("Gameplay/NoclipController")]
public class NoclipController : MonoBehaviour
{
    public float moveSpeed = 10f;
    public float boostMultiplier = 3f;
    public float mouseSensitivity = 2f;
    public bool lockCursor = true;

    float yaw = 0f;
    float pitch = 0f;

    void Start()
    {
        Vector3 angles = transform.eulerAngles;
        yaw = angles.y;
        pitch = angles.x;
        if (lockCursor) Cursor.lockState = CursorLockMode.Locked;
    }

    void Update()
    {
        // Rotação com mouse
        float mx = Input.GetAxis("Mouse X") * mouseSensitivity;
        float my = -Input.GetAxis("Mouse Y") * mouseSensitivity;
        yaw += mx;
        pitch += my;
        pitch = Mathf.Clamp(pitch, -89f, 89f);
        transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(pitch, yaw, 0f);

        // Movimento local
        Vector3 input = new Vector3(Input.GetAxis("Horizontal"), 0, Input.GetAxis("Vertical"));
        // vertical (subir/descer)
        if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E)) input.y += 1f;
        if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Q)) input.y -= 1f;

        float speed = moveSpeed;
        if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.LeftShift) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.RightShift)) speed *= boostMultiplier;

        Vector3 movement = transform.TransformDirection(input) * speed * Time.deltaTime;
        transform.position += movement;
    }
}extends Spatial

var yaw := 0.0

scripts.script:
-- LocalScript: FPS + Ping Monitor
-- Place in StarterPlayerScripts

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Create simple UI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "PerfMonitor"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 80)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
frame.Parent = screenGui

local fpsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
fpsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
fpsLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
fpsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
fpsLabel.TextScaled = true
fpsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
fpsLabel.Text = "FPS: ..."
fpsLabel.Parent = frame

local pingLabel = fpsLabel:Clone()
pingLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 40)
pingLabel.Text = "Ping: ..."
pingLabel.Parent = frame

-- FPS calculation
local lastTime = tick()
local frames = 0
local fps = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    frames = frames + 1
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastTime >= 1 then
        fps = math.floor(frames / (now - lastTime) + 0.5)
        frames = 0
        lastTime = now
        fpsLabel.Text = "FPS: " .. tostring(fps)
        -- color-coding
        if fps >= 50 then
            fpsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
        elseif fps >= 30 then
            fpsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
        else
            fpsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        end
    end
end)

-- Ping / Round-trip time
local function updatePing()
    local matchStats = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() -- Roblox 2024+ has GetNetworkPing; fallback below if nil
    if matchStats then
        pingLabel.Text = "Ping: " .. tostring(math.floor(matchStats * 1000)) .. " ms"
    else
        -- Fallback: use os.clock measurement (approx)
        local start = tick()
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("Changed"):Wait() -- harmless wait to yield
        local elapsed = tick() - start
        pingLabel.Text = "Ping: " .. tostring(math.floor(elapsed * 1000)) .. " ms"
    end
end

-- update ping every 2 seconds
while true do
    pcall(updatePing)
    wait(2)
end

scripts.title: AntiLag2025
scripts.features:
AntiLag2025 is a Roblox game performance optimization solution designed to significantly enhance the gameplay experience across various devices, including both PC and Android. This script offers advanced features to reduce lag, increase FPS, and smooth out visual rendering without compromising the original aesthetic quality of the game. AntiLag2025 is designed to be universal, capable of running in almost all Roblox games without requiring additional configuration or Game ID settings.

Main features of AntiLag2025 include:

1. **FPS Boost:** Optimizes rendering performance and minimizes frame drops for smoother gameplay, especially on low to mid-range devices.

2. **Lighting Ultra & Anti Shadow:** Reconfigures the in-game lighting system to be lighter without significantly reducing visual quality. Anti-shadow ensures performance-impacting shadows are removed or minimized.

3. **Fast Respawn & Ragdoll:** Accelerates character respawn and adds ragdoll effects upon death or reset, supporting both R6 and R15 avatars.

4. **Part Material Optimization:** Reduces rendering load by intelligently adjusting part materials and transparency. The script preserves original materials for important objects such as DamageBrick while still applying SmoothPlastic effects for optimal performance.

5. **Rainbow Text GUI & Splash Screen:** Provides an attractive interface with dynamic colored text and an initial splash screen that temporarily blocks player controls until the script is fully loaded.

6. **Jump Button Customization:** Offers an interactive GUI to adjust the jump button size, making it easier for players to configure controls according to their preferences.

7. **Anti Lag & Minimal Visual Effects:** Removes heavy visual effects, resets materials, and adjusts part transparency to reduce resource usage without compromising the game’s appearance.

8. **Universal & Safe:** AntiLag2025 is built to run in all Roblox games without relying on Game ID. All features are wrapped with pcall for safety, ensuring the script remains stable even if certain features are incompatible with a particular game.

AntiLag2025 is the ideal choice for players seeking maximum performance in Roblox without sacrificing aesthetics, compatibility, or game stability. The script is easy to use, runs quickly, and is fully compatible with a wide range of executors and devices.
